about: Every audio file the product keeps, with its license and its exact bytes. The owned lane (lib/sources/owned.ts) may only hold sound the product is free to keep, serve and play for anyone: CC0, public domain, or a commissioned sound with a written buyout. A file is owned only when its sha256 is listed here. tests/sources.test.mjs holds this list, public/samples/starter/manifest.json and lib/samples-attribution.ts to each other, and tools/audit-audio.mjs reports every audio file in the repository that is not listed.
rules: A commissioned sound carries "contract": the path or id of the signed buyout. Without it the file is not owned.
No file here may come from Splice, Tracklib, Landr, Loopcloud, Cymatics, Output or any other per-user license. Those are licensed to one person and are never the product's to keep.
Adding a sound to public/samples means adding it here in the same change, with its source page and license verified by hand.
